snippet.title: Defending the Mall - 100% All Achievements, Bios, Fails, Endings (Henry Stickmin Fangame)
snippet.description:
This is a complete walkthrough of my Henry Stickmin fangame, Defending the Mall! There's no commentary here and this video was recorded on the Bitmap version of the game, since I don't have my more powerful PC with me at college.

Defending the Mall is set in an alternate timeline to the official Henry Stickmin games, where Henry never robbed the bank and instead got an honest job working as a mall cop. He still cannot escape his cartoony escapades, however, as he soon finds himself in the midst of a mall raid.

This project is not affiliated with PuffballUnited/Innersloth, the creators of the official Henry Stickmin games. Go check 'em out on Steam!

.................................................................................................................................

Play the game for yourself:
Widescreen Versions(Download required): https://gamejolt.com/games/Defending_the_mall/1026799

Vector Scratch Version: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/900689625/

Bitmap Scratch Version: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/1225045388/

.................................................................................................................................

Watch the trailere here, which provide additional context to the game: 

Trailer 1/Reveal Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0u9TCRMxd0U

Final Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFUADJcuIsk&t=1s

.................................................................................................................................

Thank you all so much for watching, and for the continuous support I recieved while I developed this game. I hope you all like it, it's been fun! Stay tuned for my upcoming developer commentary!

#henrystickmin #stickmin #paulblart #scratch #flashgames
